info.name: Ollama Local AI
info.summary: Run large language models locally with Ollama
info.description:
Ollama allows you to run large language models (LLMs) locally on your Nextcloud server.
**Features:** - Run open-source LLMs like Llama 3, Mistral, CodeLlama, and more - Complete privacy - all processing stays on your server - GPU acceleration support (NVIDIA, AMD) - OpenAI-compatible API for easy integration - Model library with one-command downloads - Efficient memory management for running large models
**Supported Models:** - Llama 3.2 (Meta's latest model) - Mistral 7B (Great for general tasks) - CodeLlama (Optimized for coding) - Phi-3 (Microsoft's efficient model) - Gemma 2 (Google's open model) - And many more from the Ollama library
**Use with:** - Open WebUI ExApp for a chat interface - Nextcloud Assistant for AI-powered features - OpenRegister for RAG and agent capabilities
This ExApp runs Ollama as a sidecar container managed by Nextcloud's AppAPI.
info.author: Conduction

variable.name: OLLAMA_DEFAULT_MODEL
variable.description: Model to pull on first startup (default: llama3.2:3b)

variable.name: OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE
variable.description: How long to keep models loaded (default: 15m)

variable.name: OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS
variable.description: Maximum models to keep in memory (default: 1)
